contract.definition: loanRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequests->any(lr: LoanRequest | lr.RequestID = id), approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter = self.CurrentApprovalLetter
contract.postcondition: self.CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and approvalLetter.Content = 'standard content' and self.CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and result = true
